verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.131
14. Puggalavagga
Saṁyojanasutta
“Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
Idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni honti.
verses.english: One individual hasn’t given up the lower fetters, the fetters for getting reborn, or the fetters for getting a continued existence.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni honti.
verses.english: One individual has given up the lower fetters, but not the fetters for getting reborn, or the fetters for getting a continued existence.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni honti.
verses.english: One individual has given up the lower fetters and the fetters for getting reborn, but not the fetters for getting a continued existence.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni honti.
verses.english: One individual has given up the lower fetters, the fetters for getting reborn, and the fetters for getting a continued existence.

verses.pali: Katamassa, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni?
verses.english: What individual hasn’t given up the lower fetters, the fetters for getting reborn, or the fetters for getting a continued existence?

verses.pali: Sakadāgāmissa.
Imassa kho, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni.
verses.english: This is the individual who hasn’t given up the lower fetters, the fetters for getting reborn, or the fetters for getting a continued existence.

verses.pali: Katamassa, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni?
verses.english: What individual has given up the lower fetters, but not the fetters for getting reborn, or the fetters for getting a continued existence?

verses.pali: Uddhaṁsotassa akaniṭṭhagāmino.
verses.english: One heading upstream, going to the Akaniṭṭha realm.

verses.pali: Imassa kho, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni.
Katamassa, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni?
verses.english: What individual has given up the lower fetters and the fetters for getting reborn, but not the fetters for getting a continued existence?

verses.pali: Antarāparinibbāyissa.
verses.english: One extinguished between one life and the next.

verses.pali: Imassa kho, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni appahīnāni.
Katamassa, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni?
verses.english: What individual has given up the lower fetters, the fetters for getting reborn, and the fetters for getting a continued existence?

verses.pali: Arahato.
Imassa kho, bhikkhave, puggalassa orambhāgiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṁyojanāni pahīnāni.
Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Paṭhamaṁ.
